description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An enemy within 30 feet scores a critical hit against you or an ally.

Cost 1 Zeal

Turn an incoming critical hit into a normal one.

Reduce the triggering critical hit to a normal hit. This is a misfortune effect. The Croupier redeals the hand — once.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Trigger an enemy crits you or an ally within 30 feet, Cost 1 Zeal: reduce that crit to a normal hit" is blocked twice over: P-DEGREE-REACTIVE (a reactive, frequency-gated fix applied after an unwanted roll is already known) and P-CROSS (the roll being fixed is a DIFFERENT creature's -- the attacker's crit, not the card holder's own). Separately blocked by P-ZEAL for the Cost 1 Zeal clause, but not the deciding factor.
